sentences.text: Whereby, the tribunal had granted compensation of an amount of Rs.17,08,660/-.
The claimants are before this Court seeking enhancement of the compensation.

2. Learned counsel appearing for the claimant submits that the tribunal had failed to take the income at Rs.12,500/- and this accident had taken place in the year 2018 and had failed to grant reasonable compensation on the conventional heads also.
It is submitted that the amount that is awarded by the Tribunal is not just and reasonable compensation.
3. Learned counsel appearing for the respondent/insurance company submits that the tribunal has considered all these aspects and granted a just and reasonable compensation.
4. Having heard the learned counsels on either side, perused the material on record.

In this case, the accident had NC: 2025:KHC:24871 HC-KAR taken place in the year 2018 and the national income has to be taken at Rs.12,500/- considering the age of the deceased, who was aged about 40, future prospects at 25% comes to an amount of Rs.3,125/- the income is Rs.15,625/- as there are four claimants 1/4 has to be deducted i.e., Rs.3,906/- towards his personal expenses and the contribution to the family would be Rs.11,719/-.

Under the head of loss of dependency it would come to an amount of Rs.21,09,420/- (11,719 x 12 x 15) under the head of consortium' (4 x 44,000)
Rs.1,76,000/- and towards 'funeral expenses' a sum of Rs.36,000/- is granted.
5. Altogether, the claimants are entitled for compensation of an amount of Rs.23,21,420/-.

i) Accordingly, the appeal is partly allowed by enhancing the compensation from an amount of Rs.17,08,660/- to Rs.23,21,420/- along with interest at the rate of 6% per annum from the date of petition till the date of realization.
ii) Both the Insurance Companies are jointly and severally liable to pay the compensation within a period of eight weeks from the date of receipt of copy of the judgment.
On such deposit, the NC: 2025:KHC:24871 HC-KAR claimants are entitled to withdraw the entire amount without furnishing any security.
iii) The apportionment of the amount shall be as per the award passed by the Tribunal.
